QTester104 for Windows 10/11 x64

1. Extract the entire ZIP into a writable folder.
2. Run the included vc_redist.x64.exe to install the Microsoft Visual C++
   runtime. Accept the elevation prompt if requested. If a newer runtime is
   already installed, keep it. Restart Windows if the installer requests it.
3. Edit qtester104.ini with your device's connection settings.
4. Run QTester104.exe.

Keep the Qt DLLs and plugin folders alongside QTester104.exe. Copying only
QTester104.exe is not sufficient. See readme.txt for application usage and
License-gpl-3.0.txt for the license.
